# m.options.greeks

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The end-of-day greeks and implied volatility of each US-listed options contract.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.options.greeks(symbols=None, *, underlying=None, contract_type=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol` and `Date`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Option contracts; leave it out for every contract. |
| `underlying` | The underlying's exact Massive ticker, such as `"AAPL"` or `"I:SPX"`, or several; leave it out for every underlying. A row of an underlying you didn't ask for, such as the stock `DJT`'s in Massive's answer for the index `I:DJT`, follows the `unrequested_symbols` cause of `on_error`. |
| `contract_type` | `dm.ContractType.CALL` or `PUT`; leave it out for both. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first trading day. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last trading day. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"implied_volatility"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"expiration_date": "2026-12-18"}`. Keys: `expiration_date`. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Historical Greeks & IV (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Options Basic | Not included |
| Options Starter | Not included |
| Options Developer | Not included |
| Options Advanced | End-of-day, All history |
| Options Business | Not included |
| Historical Options Analytics Business | End-of-day, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "Options contract ticker in Massive format (e.g. O:AMD261121C00220000)". |
| `Date` | String | The trading date the values reflect |
| `OptionRoot` | String | Option root symbol |
| `BidPrice` | double | NBBO bid 15 minutes before the close |
| `AskPrice` | double | NBBO ask 15 minutes before the close |
| `Volume` | long | Contracts traded on date |
| `ContractType` | String | call or put |
| `Delta` | double | Change in option price per $1 move in the underlying |
| `DividendYield` | double | The most recent regular dividend by ex-date times its yearly frequency, divided by underlying_price, as a decimal. 0 if none |
| `ExerciseStyle` | String | american or european |
| `ExpirationDate` | String | Contract expiration date |
| `Gamma` | double | Change in delta per $1 move in the underlying |
| `ImpliedVolatility` | double | Annualized implied volatility solved against option_price, as a decimal (0.48 means 48%). Null when the solver cannot produce a value |
| `Model` | String | Pricing model: binomial |
| `OpenInterest` | long | Open interest as published the morning of date, for the prior trading day's close. Massive publishes it the morning of `Date`, for the prior trading day's close, so it is the value `m.options.open_interest()` dates one trading day earlier. |
| `OptionPrice` | double | The option price the solver used: the NBBO midpoint 15 minutes before the close |
| `QuoteTimestamp` | Instant | Nanosecond timestamp of the NBBO used |
| `Rho` | double | Change in option price per 1 percentage point move in the risk-free rate |
| `RiskFreeRate` | double | Annualized Treasury yield at the option's maturity, interpolated on the curve published before date, as a decimal |
| `StrikePrice` | double | Contract strike price |
| `Theta` | double | Change in option price per calendar day |
| `UnderlyingPrice` | double | Underlying price used by the solver: the last SIP trade, or the last published index value, at or before 15 minutes before the close |
| `Underlying` | String | The instrument Massive lists the row under, as Massive's ticker. From REST `underlying_ticker`: "Underlying symbol". Massive's `root` is the `OptionRoot` column. An index has its `I:` prefix (`I:SPX`), as in `m.options.contracts()`. If Massive's [Contract Overview](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/contracts/contract-overview) can't say whether a root is an index, the library leaves its rows out and lists them in `m.problems()` as `unreadable_symbols`. |
| `UnderlyingTimestamp` | Instant | Nanosecond timestamp of the underlying price used |
| `Vega` | double | Change in option price per 1 point move in implied volatility |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
